description.zh: 是否匹配所有文件前缀。
description.en: Specifies whether to match all file prefixes.

description.zh: 最大解压文件数。最小取值为1，最大取值为1000。超过最大解压文件数时，解压操作将直接结束，已解压出文件的检测不受影响。
description.en: The maximum number of files to decompress. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 1000. If the maximum number of decompressed files is exceeded, the decompression operation stops. The detection of already decompressed files is not affected.

description.zh: 存在多个层级的压缩包嵌套时的最大解压层数，最小取值为1，最大取值为5。超过最大解压层数时，解压操作将直接结束，已解压出文件的检测不受影响。
description.en: The maximum number of decompression layers for nested compressed files. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 5. If the maximum number of decompression layers is exceeded, the decompression operation stops. The detection of already decompressed files is not affected.

Specifies whether to enable the scan policy. Valid values:
- **1**: Enable.
- **0**: Disable.
The scan end time in the HH:mm:ss format.

description.zh: 检测最后一次修改时间在指定时间戳之后的文件，单位毫秒。
description.en: Scans files whose last modification time is after the specified timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 是否开启实时增量检测。此参数设置为true时，参数ScanDayList、StartTime、EndTime不生效。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable real-time incremental detection. If this parameter is set to true, the ScanDayList, StartTime, and EndTime parameters do not take effect.

description.zh: 扫描时间，数字表示一周中的第几天。
description.en: The scan days. The number indicates the day of the week.
The scan start time in the HH:mm:ss format.
